en.v: Many old houses around our school will be
down next year and a large green area will appear.

examples.zh: 明年我们学校周围许多旧房子要被拆除，将出现一片大型的绿化区域。

errata.original: Many old houses around our school will be pulled down next year …（下划线在 be 上）
errata.corrected: Many old houses around our school will be pulled down next year …（下划线在 pulled 上）
errata.note: 例句下划线应标在词目形式 pulled 上，原书误标在 be 上；经人工复核（GitHub #135 第 92 条）确认更正
